title: UniLasso
tagline: UniLasso is a hook that is limit order allowing you to sit back and relax!
description: This project is intended to take profit after the value of a token goes above a certain limit in Uniswap v4. The goal is see get the price by looking at the ticks and based on that mint an order token and then when the user want to redeem it, they can. They are able to place order and cancel order. I also created a counter smart contract. (My first smart contract!)
how_its_made: I used uniswap v4 API and deployed it to the test net. I followed a lot of the internet guides and telegram channels. I deployed the counter smart contract onto Mantle and Scroll since uni v4 isn't available yet, I wanted to learn the end to end process. I used Redux IDE to deploy.
